missions.name: Basic Training
missions.premise: Four target drone flights in the asteroid belt. Standard fleet checkout—until a civilian freighter starts screaming on the guard band.
missions.primary: Clear all four training drone flights.
missions.secondary: Bring at least one starting fighter squadron through intact.
missions.bonus: Finish before range control calls the second time check.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Four drone flights. Dummies on their racks, live rounds on yours. Don't make a meal of it.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: They told me the drones were harmless on my checkout too. Clipped a thruster on number three. Buying the deck crew drinks for a month.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Hold on—getting a mayday on civilian guard. Ore hauler out of Morrow Gate. Says she's taking torpedo fire.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Finish your range table, Lieutenant. Picket ships have Morrow Gate.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Sir, that's the picket ship relaying the mayday.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Checkout's logged. Plot for Core Outskirts—you jump in ten.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: And here I ironed my dress whites.

missions.name: Core Outskirts
missions.premise: Rebel torpedo bombers are making a run on the Core Outskirts freight ring—and one of them is squawking an Imperial Navy transponder.
missions.secondary: Keep the bombers off the station registry hub.
missions.bonus: Log the bomber's Imperial transponder serial.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Three rebel bomber flights on an attack vector for the transfer ring. Bulk freight's already backed up to the jump buoy. Clear the lane.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I've got station control on the secondary. Yard crews haven't cleared the outer gantry yet, Commander—get our fighters in front of those bombers.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Wait a second. That lead bomber's squawking a Navy transit cipher. Six-series, eighteen months old, still green in the table.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Salvage yards leak transponders every week. Flag the serial for Fleet Intel and stay on the bombers.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I tried. Intel's server bounced the packet before the upload even finished.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Station's back on comms. Venting atmosphere on B-deck, but the harbourmaster got his clerks into the shelter.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Leave the station to the tugs. We've pinned down Garric Holt's flagship in the boneyard.

missions.name: System Patrol
missions.premise: Pirate boss Garric Holt is hiding a salvaged battlecruiser among the hulks of the old fleet boneyard.
missions.secondary: Capture the tight-beam burst from Holt's bridge before his hull breaks.
missions.bonus: Bring at least one fighter squadron back.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Garric Holt has been stripping Navy hulks in this sector for three years. That dreadnought in the debris field is his. Sink it.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Three cannon frigates parked on his bow. I'll swing the fighters wide around the scrap—no sense feeding them into his main battery.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, hold your fire! This is Holt's relay—he's carrying harbour logs from the Thessa evacuation. Check what your Admiral paid him to scrap!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Jamming spoofs. Keep your guns on the dreadnought.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: They just dumped a forty-kilobyte text file into our buffer. Funny kind of jamming.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Reactor's gone—Holt's breaking up. His tight-beam finished writing to my recorder right before the core went.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Purge the recorder buffer. You're hitting Holt's asteroid anchorage before his crews can torch the vaults.

missions.name: Pirate Base
missions.premise: Holt's rock-cut anchorage holds salvage manifests from the Thessa run—and Navy payment vouchers for every hull he broke up.
missions.primary: Wipe out the anchorage defence ships.
missions.secondary: Pull the harbour manifests from the rock vault.
missions.bonus: Keep a frigate intact to haul the vault drives.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Holt's anchorage is cut into the big rock dead ahead. One flak frigate on the door, four fighter flights on patrol. Go in fast.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Lot of flak for a gang of scrap-haulers. Somebody didn't want visitors reading the ledger.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I'm inside their dock ledger. These aren't pirate prizes—they're civilian hulls from the Thessa corridor, tagged with that same six-series Navy cipher.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Leave the harbour drives for the intelligence detail, Lieutenant.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Hull 44-Meridian's on this sheet, sir. My brother was third mate on the Meridian.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Look at the timestamps. Naval Command declared the Thessa lane hostile twelve minutes before the refugee ships reached the buoy.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Shut that channel down, Kest. You can put it on my desk when we're back in port.

missions.name: Military Excursion
missions.premise: Command sends you two jumps into rebel space to rescue former transit director Dr. Leena Sar—who insists she wasn't kidnapped.
missions.primary: Hold the pickup point for five minutes.
missions.secondary: Bring the courier shuttle out alive.
missions.bonus: Get Dr. Sar's ledger drives aboard your flagship.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Rebel raiders took Dr. Leena Sar out of Transit Records last week. Boarding team's cutting her out of that courier now—hold the jump point for five minutes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Two jumps inside rebel space with one tide window out. Keep the frigates tight on that shuttle.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, this is Leena Sar. Stop firing on my escorts—nobody kidnapped me. I walked out of Records when Vey's office told me to burn the Thessa tapes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Hell of a time to mention it, Doctor.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: I filed three safe-conduct requests with the Inspectorate. Admiral Vey sent a shore patrol with sidearms.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Put the boarding shuttle in your hangar and cut her transmitter, Commander.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Those transports had green clearance from my own dispatchers. The fleet closed the lane without warning and opened up on everything in the chute.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: The Meridian was in that column.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Fourth ship hit. I still have the fire-control order, Lieutenant—with your Admiral's seal at the bottom.

missions.name: All out war
missions.premise: Commander Nara Sen's strike group pushes for the capital's Crown Relay, intent on broadcasting the Thessa gun-camera tape to every ship in the sector.
missions.primary: Break the rebel vanguard off the capital station.
missions.secondary: Intercept the bombers before they hit the civilian berths.
missions.bonus: Keep a clean copy of Sen's open-band broadcast.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Rebel vanguard's inside the outer marker. Their command staff is on that destroyer—kill it before they get within line-of-sight of the Crown Relay.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Harbour control still has civilian hulls tied up on the ring! I'm telling the dockmaster to blow the moorings.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, this is Commander Nara Sen. We're only here for the Crown Relay. Let our signal through and every ship in the Navy hears what happened at Thessa.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: She's putting torpedoes into a commercial berth while she lectures you. Kill the destroyer.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: We broadcast evacuation warnings an hour ago! Vey locked the berth gates to keep your fleet between us and the dish!

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Check the port log, Commander—she did call it in. Twice. Port authority overrode the undock.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Vanguard destroyer's dead in the water. Wait—long-range scopes just lit up. That wasn't the main body. Sen's heavy hulls already slipped past us.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Come about for the palace approach. Full burn.

missions.name: Final Assault
missions.premise: Two rebel destroyers push through the palace wreck field while civilian and cabinet transports scramble for the same narrow exit lane.
missions.primary: Hold the wreck-field approach for five minutes.
missions.secondary: Keep the outbound transport lane clear.
missions.bonus: Cover Transport Three until its crew clears the buoy.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Inner picket's gone. Two rebel destroyers are coming straight through the hulk field—hold the throat for five minutes.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Outbound transports are bottlenecked behind us. Dock workers, families, ministry aides—all trying to squeeze down one buoy line.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Pull your frigates onto Transport One. The defence committee is aboard.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Transport Three's trailing plasma from her port main—she's got four hundred yard hands aboard and she's falling behind!

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: My clerks are on Three with the physical dispatch books, Commander. If that hull goes, the paper trail goes with it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: You have your orders, Commander.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: We can't screen both lanes! Tell me where to put the guns.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Transports are clear of the buoy, but Sen's flagship is already lining up on the Crown Relay dish.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: She's outrun her escorts. One push and we finish this before she keys the array.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Guns are hot, Commander. Point us where you want us.

missions.name: Last Hope
missions.premise: Sen's dreadnought is on final approach to the Crown Relay. Take down her flagship—then decide what happens to the tape in your buffer.
missions.secondary: Hold the tight-beam transfer from Sen's bridge.
missions.bonus: Bring at least one capital ship through the fight.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Sen's dreadnought is two thousand metres off the relay dish. Break her hull and this rebellion dies right here.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Ninth Fleet, you've got Sar's ledger in your cabin. Check the seal on the closure order before you die for the man who wrote it.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: I ran the key against Fleet Registry five minutes ago. It's his seal.

lines.speaker: sen
lines.text: Main bus is dead—we won't reach the dish. Dumping the raw gun-camera tape straight to your flagship's array. Don't let him bury us twice.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Cut your receiving array! Direct order!

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Transfer's complete. That's the last unedited copy in the sector, Commander.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Flagship's gone. The Crown Relay is locked onto our transponder, waiting for a command key.

lines.speaker: sar
lines.text: Key the dish and the whole sector hears the tape before the Admiralty can pull the breakers. Or lock the drive, and it never leaves this bridge.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Put the drive under seal, Commander. Don't make me ask twice.

endings.choice: Put the Thessa tape on the Crown Relay.
endings.title: Open Channel
endings.text: The gun-camera tape hits the outer beacons twelve minutes before Naval Command cuts power to the dish. Two border squadrons refuse orders before noon; a third comes about for the capital. Vey is relieved of his flag by nightfall. The shooting along the rim doesn't stop, but nobody pretends not to know how it started.

endings.choice: Lock the drive for an Admiralty board.
endings.title: Closed Inquiry
endings.text: Fleet dispatches credit the Ninth with breaking the siege. The Crown Relay stays on routine traffic, and Vey chairs the board of inquiry himself. By winter the border patrols are back on their old stations. Kest turns in her flight wings the morning the medals are pinned, leaving the Meridian's hull tag on the briefing table.
